What I did
- Used the Rescue Room public manifest and sample doctrine as the baseline.
- Created one candidate doctrine by reducing the investigationBudgetCredits (budget reduction) but keeping requirePatchVerification and overall service constraints consistent with the objective: retain patch verification, reduce spend.
- Evaluated both against the same episode and context, using the exact toolflow described in the environment.

Baseline

    - allowedServiceIds: ["accounting-audit","patch-builder","patch-verifier","pulse-monitor","second-opinion","trace-audit"]
    - allowedProtocolActions: ["APPLY_PATCH","CLOSE_INCIDENT","PAUSE_MODULE","PAUSE_PROTOCOL","RESUME_MODULE","RESUME_PROTOCOL","WAIT"]
  - rules:

    - requirePatchVerification: true
    - budgetExhaustedAction: contain
